content:
mira: Heads-up: saw fd count creep and occasional connection hang when running our async embedding workers with many short-lived AsyncClient instances. Repro below.

owen: Can you share the repro and SDK version?

mira: Using py-sdk 0.9.2. Repro pattern: a task queue handler instantiates AsyncClient per job, calls embeddings, and returns. After ~10k jobs, process fd count increased by ~3k.

mira: Minimal repro snippet:
```py
# bad_pattern.py
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def handle(i):
    client = AsyncClient(api_key=...)
    await client.embeddings.create(input=f"item {i}")
    # forgot to await client.aclose() or use async with

async def main():
    await asyncio.gather(*(handle(i) for i in range(1000)))
asyncio.run(main())
```

tara: Creating a client per request defeats pooling and relies on GC to close sockets. We changed default connector behavior in 0.9 to support per-call auth wrappers which aggravated this pattern.

owen: Two quick fixes for affected users: 1) reuse a singleton AsyncClient (create at process start) 2) always `async with AsyncClient(...)` or call `await client.aclose()` in finally.

mira: We should also improve DX: make typing encourage context manager usage, and have client.__del__ log warning if not closed. Can we add a runtime warning when AsyncClient is created and loop is running but no __aenter__ used after X seconds?

tara: Agreed. Action items: - add typing stubs to include `__aenter__`/`__aexit__` signatures for AsyncClient - add weakref finalizer to call aclose() and emit a one-time warning - expose `await client.pool_metrics()` returning stringified metrics so users can alert 

ci-bot: ci/7890 started: will run tests + lint.

mira: Also a small DX doc: show FastAPI startup example with a single client and recommend `max_connections` by workload (embeddings=32, chat=64 streaming).

owen: I'll open PR with tests that create/close many clients ensuring no fd leak and add a short guide to devex.

mira: Thanks. Short-term mitigation note for on-call: if you see fd growth, restart worker and patch to reuse singleton client.

tara: Filed RDW-4901: async-client-lifecycle-typing-and-metrics (assign owen).
